source.note: BLOCKED on this repository's backends: a 22-stage RadFrac extractive column with a phenol solvent feed above stage 7 is not available (the DWSIM server's rigorous column could not be given a feed stage here, see architecture doc section 13). The case is kept as a recorded answer key for a column-capable backend (Aspen or a fixed DWSIM). Property method UNIFAC (stated in the guide). Two printed values disagree: the design-specification table gives a phenol flow of 1515.07763 lbmol/h and the text beside it says approximately 1517.1; linear interpolation of the printed sensitivity table to 98.0 percent gives 1516.9
